### Regular Papers

Welcome to the Regular Papers section of CAAD Futures 2025. This page provides essential information for authors of accepted `Springer Book` and `Companion/Compendium Book` papers. Please review the details below carefully.

#### Conference Details

- **Dates**: 2–4 July 2025
- **Location**: The University of Hong Kong

#### Important Information for All Paper Authors

- **Registration Requirement**: Each accepted paper must have at least one uniquely registered author.
- **Submission Format**:
  - Submit both the original file (DOC or LaTeX) and an exported PDF version.
  - Package these files in a ZIP folder for submission via EasyChair.
  - Download the paper template in [`DOC or LaTeX format`](https://www.springer.com/gp/computer-science/lncs/conference-proceedings-guidelines).
- **Spelling Consistency**: We kindly ask that you use consistent British English spelling conventions throughout your manuscript.
- **Contact for Invitation Letters**: Request an invitation letter for travel arrangements by emailing <mark>caadfutures2025@hku.hk</mark> with your submission ID.


### Springer Book Papers

- Key Dates
  - **Final Abstract Submission**: <mark>26 May 2025</mark> (for inclusion in the Companion/Compendium Book)
  - **Final Publication**: After the conference, end of July 2025
- Requirements
  - **Anonymization**: Ensure your submission is fully anonymized.
  - **Response to Reviewers**: Include a point-by-point response to reviewers as a DOC or PDF within your submission ZIP package.

### Companion/Compendium Book Papers

- Key Dates
  - **Final Camera-Ready Paper**: <mark>26 May 2025</mark>

- Requirements
  - **Reviewer Feedback**: Authors are strongly encouraged to address reviewer feedback in the final submission.
  - **Anonymization**: Final papers should **not** be anonymized.
  - **DOI Assignment**: All accepted papers will be assigned a DOI.
  - Supplementary Materials: Authors may include supporting media (e.g., video or image summaries). Guidelines will be released shortly.

### Poster Exhibition
  - **Submission**: Submission:  All Companion/Compendium Book authors are invited to submit a poster by <mark>2 June 2025</mark> using this [template](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1x_hUbIyT1zq88_W8axd_BKPpC45SdBPe)
  - **Details**: Posters will be displayed throughout the conference with dedicated plenary sessions for viewing and discussion.

### Highlight Presentations
A select number of outstanding Companion/Compendium papers will be chosen for short-form presentations during a plenary session. Selection will be announced by the end of the month.
